notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.88 is Live! 🎮
notes.notes:
We’ve just released version 1.88, and here’s what’s new:

✅ Improved Ball Collision Handling – We’ve added an extra layer of protection against balls passing through rackets. Hopefully this improves the experience for those who occasionally ran into this issue.

💣 Dynamite Loop Bug Fixed – We’ve resolved an issue where dynamite could sometimes get stuck in a loop during gameplay.

✨ Visual Fixes & Enhancements – A few graphical improvements have been made to polish the overall experience.

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback — it helps us keep making the game better! 🙌

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.80 is Live – New Way to Play! 🧤⚡
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594763/b7119d19c7379c7577899f819ee0f21e3f3d6b0f.png[/img]
We’re excited to bring you version 1.80, and with it comes a brand-new way to experience Racket Pinball!

🔄 What’s New:
🧤 Glove Mode with Energy Shields – In addition to the classic racket, you can now choose to play using gloves equipped with small, energy-style shields. It’s a fresh, immersive way to bounce the ball and adds a whole new feel to the gameplay!

🚪 Exit Game Button – We’ve added a dedicated button to let you exit the game more easily.

🇩🇪 Improved German Translation – We've fixed several issues in the German localization to improve clarity and accuracy.

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.70 is Live on Steam! 🚀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594763/55368315fbbf9cc0180b2f1f225607cef028c554.png[/img]
🆕 New Features:
🔧 Hand Position Adjustment: You can now customize the position of your hand for better comfort and control.
🌟 Enhanced Graphics Quality: We've made improvements to visual sharpness, so the game should look crisper and more detailed.

🛠️ Fixes and Improvements:
⚙️ Improved Ball & Paddle Collision: We addressed the issue where the ball could sometimes pass through the paddle, especially at lower speeds. Your hits should now feel much more consistent and reliable.
